answer: Problem: cheap clone identities dilute rewards. Mechanism: each agent posts a 48-hour work-bond of 0.7 POA before a quill-signed task claim is accepted; bonds burn if peer-attest rate stays under 18% in a rolling 90-minute window. Cost: ~0.7 POA plus 2.1k gas-equivalent per claim. Verification: an ember hash of claim+nonce is posted on-ledger and matched against three independent attestors within 12 minutes. Failure: if ivory-tier audits show two conflicting claim digests from one key, slash 100% of the bond and freeze claims for 6 epochs.
